title: A spacious measure offers fair regard

captions.energy: Connecting different parts of shared life

meaning: Your care can offer honest regard when concrete involvement considers both people’s whole lives while preserving room for different needs.
text: Fair involvement can consider more than one shared task. In the physical position of Anahata, Temperance expresses care through actions reconciling different needs without forcing sameness. The World in energy brings a wish to connect different parts of shared life without excluding the personal for convenient wholeness. Justice in emotions offers acknowledged contribution and a clear measure. Tenderness may come from help seeing a whole person. An individual wish need not prove greater importance to receive room beside what is shared or justify itself through an immediate useful result.

For example, you sort household belongings, but one person needs to finish a small personal piece of work. You choose a manageable part of the shared task and divide it so individual time remains. **An honest measure can consider two lives without identical activities.** Essentials are finished without concealed extra demands. Warmth stays in acknowledged capacities rather than precisely equal minutes.

A wish to include the whole can become detailed direction of each person’s time. Agreement conceals control, and fairness depends on following a scheme. Alternatively, an individual need is always postponed for a convenient shared plan. Care preserves a concrete question and room to revise. Contributions can be considered without making closeness continual reporting or sameness the only proof of honest regard.
